# Resume Evidence Ledger

Every future resume claim from this project should be traceable to concrete experiment evidence.

## Rules

- Do not write a number from memory.
- Do not round in a way that changes the conclusion.
- Distinguish percentage points from relative percent change.
- State the evaluation set/protocol when the number is not self-explanatory.
- Do not claim causal improvement when the comparison contains a material confounder.
- Do not use smoke/pilot metrics as final project results.

## Technical-scope claims

Track evidence for non-numeric claims too, such as:

- completed 20k-sample medical SFT;
- implemented correctness-gated hybrid reward;
- integrated DAPO-style Dynamic Sampling with on-policy refill;
- completed full Vanilla and Dynamic GSPO runs;
- validated checkpoint resume;
- deployed vLLM OpenAI-compatible service;
- benchmarked TTFT/TPOT/throughput.

For each, link the implementation/run/stage evidence.
